basic_info.description: This sophisticated top-floor condo at Francisco Court is quietly tucked away at the rear of the building, offering a seamless blend of modern comfort and classic charm. Accessed through a secure gate, the condo overlooks a beautifully landscaped courtyard, providing both privacy and tranquility. Interior highlights include white oak hardwood floors, double-paned casement windows, and original period details. The spacious living room, with views of the courtyard, flows effortlessly into the dining areaperfect for everyday living or entertaining. The kitchen has been tastefully renovated with stainless steel appliances, including a gas range, along with granite and walnut countertops. The two bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned on opposite sides of the unit for maximum privacy, each offering generous closet space. The elegant bathroom features a skylight, marble finishes, and a walk-in shower. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, storage, and one-car parking. Residents also enjoy access to a shared patio overlooking a signature palm tree. Ideally located in the heart of Russian Hill near Fort Mason, Francisco Park, the vibrant Polk Street corridor, Ghirardelli Square, and multiple public transit options.
